basic_info.description: This wonderful home is situated in a 3-unit building built in 1990, located in the desirable, sunny Inner Mission district. In 2013, a prior owner thoughtfully created a 4th bedroom from the large living room layout. Therefore, currently the home boasts 4 bedrooms and 2 updated bathrooms, but legally a 3 bedroom home per 3R. Enjoy entertaining with the open floor plan and updated kitchen with new appliances, quartz counters and new lighting.  The recent renovations created a more modern aesthetic.  This lovely home also includes in-unit laundry, ample storage, a communal garden and deeded 1-car parking. Low HOA dues in a pay-as-you-go building.  Recent special assessments for the exterior painting and updates to the communal garden paid by the seller.  The home is near the BART station, tech shuttle routes, restaurants and shops, and with easy access to freeway.  This is turn key and a great opportunity for those wishing to create a home in this vibrant neighborhood.
